text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — I need to swap primary for the 13:00-17:00 UTC window today. I have a dentist appointment and will be out of reach for ~30m. Can someone take primary, I can stay secondary if needed.

Samir Patel: I can take primary for that window. Quick Q: any ongoing customer-impacting threads that need overlap?

Maya Chen: No active P1s. We did have a degraded embeddings cache last night but ops runbook verified resolved. Still, would be ideal if you can watch the artifact pipeline at 13:15 for the scheduled shard compaction.

Priya Nadar: I can be secondary for that slot and do a 15-min overlap at 13:00 so handoff is clean.

incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident digest generated for last 24h: 1 P1 (resolved), 2 P2s (investigating). See /incidents/1742998000 for details.

Jonah Lee: tagging infra on the compaction — @infra-oncall FYI, scheduled compaction at 13:15 might cause small latency spikes to hosted inference. If we see >5% error rate PagerDuty to notify.

Samir Patel: noted. Can you paste the quick runbook checklist for primary duties? Want to make sure I don't miss anything.

Maya Chen: sure — copy of minimal primary checklist from runbook:

```
Primary on-call quick checklist:
- ACK any new pages within 2min
- Check /dashboards/inference/latency for 5m and 1h trends
- If error rate >3% for 5m, run `scripts/collect-traces --since 10m`
- If throughput drops >10% vs baseline, restart `inference-router` on zone A
- Escalate to Eng-SRE if service degradation persists >20min
- Post summary to #eng-oncall and notify customer-success for any customer-facing impact
```

Maya Chen: runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ONCALL/pages/Runbook (section: Primary Responsibilities)

Priya Nadar: Also add: if you get pages about model fallback (ranker->small), check the smart-routing logs and confirm fallback reason before escalating. Usually a cache eviction or kernel mismatch.

Samir Patel: understood. I'll be online at 12:50 UTC for a 10-min overlap to sync.

Maya Chen: thanks — I'll leave a quick note in the incident channel if anything changes.

pagerduty-bot: [AUTO] Scheduled handoff reminder: primary swap at 13:00 UTC. Caller: Maya Chen -> Samir Patel. Secondary: Priya Nadar. Escalation policy: eng-oncall-default.

Jonah Lee: quick coverage gap note: I'm offline 14:30-15:00 UTC (calendar). If a P1 pages in that 30m and both primary+secondary are busy, please ping me in DMs; I'll step in if urgent.

Samir Patel: acked. I can cover up to 15:30 if needed. Priya can escalate to Jonah DM if we both are tied.

Maya Chen: perfect. Thanks all — swap confirmed. Leaving my status set to OOO with contact in emergency only. :lock: :wave:

Priya Nadar: thanks — I'll monitor slack and the alerts dash at 13:00 during overlap.

Samir Patel: taking primary now. Will post a short handoff note at 13:05 with any observations.

incident-bot: [AUTO] If a new P1 is detected during the swap window, notify both primary and secondary immediately and post incident playbook link.

Maya Chen: appreciated — back by 17:10 UTC, will re-confirm when I'm back online.

Samir Patel: good luck at the dentist! :grin:
file_comment: primary/secondary rotation confirmation and swap for 13:00-17:00 UTC
